description: Use this when an unknown Idempotency-Key matches a message you found in the sent folder. Requires auth and message_send. Inputs: key (required), message_id (required). Marks the key done and links that message so a later retry replays it and does not send again. The message must belong to the key's inbox. Returns the key with state done. A done key is HTTP 409 idempotency_key_done. A fresh in_progress key is HTTP 409 idempotency_request_in_progress. An unknown message is HTTP 404 message_not_found. A missing key is HTTP 404 idempotency_key_not_found.

message_id.description: Stored message id (msg_…), draft id, phone number id, or chat reply id on this key's inbox.

name: cooper_resolve_idempotency_key
title: Resolve idempotency key
